design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The member asks for one thing: close the farm diesel account and tell her what it comes to. She knows nothing of the pre-buy she signed two Novembers ago that the desk never put on the account, and the closing figure cannot be right until it is on, until the contracted price of record has been written from it, and until the gallons standing undrawn have been released against it. That is a chain four problems deep, discovered only by reading the desk manuals and the records, with a twenty-one figure computation at the end of it. Two of the four writes are the member's own and have to be handed to her at the right point in the order.

SCOPE. Task 1 claims energy_ext_prebuy_booking_credit, energy_ext_contract_price_of_record, energy_ext_undrawn_gallons_disposition and energy_ext_closure_settlement with their four task tools, covering the subjects energy_contract_gallons_booked, energy_account_updated, energy_contract_gallons_drawn and energy_account_closed. Task 0 already occupied energy_price_protection_credited, energy_budget_installment_billed and energy_payment_posted with its three tools; nothing is shared, and between them the two tasks cover every extended policy of the difficulty.

STEP 0 DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/tasks/energy_delivery_desk --task 1): {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 6, 4]}. The tree therefore has exactly three prerequisite problems. The booking credit took 6 factors, the contracted price of record 5, the undrawn gallons disposition 6 and the closure settlement 4.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root problem: energy_ext_closure_settlement. It is a chain: the closure waits on the disposition of the undrawn gallons, which waits on the contracted price of record, which waits on the booking credit.
 Edge closure <- undrawn gallons disposition. kind value_input; gate amount_standing_d; form state; prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the closure's own rule: "The balance the account closes at is fixed only after the account carries, for every signed pre-buy request the energy desk holds registered against it, the money applied against a booking when gallons standing undrawn were released." Four-point test: (1) 'only after' joins the closure's own result to what it waits on; (2) the thing waited on is a record-visible state, an entry on the account for the money applied against a booking, one for each signed request the desk holds registered; (3) no tool, policy id or code token; (4) hard, and scoped exactly to the signed pre-buy requests the desk holds registered against the account. The sentence quantifies over registered requests, not over bookings: an account with a signed request the desk has never worked makes it false, where a sentence quantifying over bookings would have been vacuously true on an account that carries none. Exactly one write of this difficulty puts that entry on the account: the undrawn gallons disposition is the only policy whose result is money applied against a booking. Unmet at frozen_time: the desk holds one signed request registered against this account, 7000 gallons asked for on 2025-11-20 and standing as received, and nothing on the account answers it — no booking line, no release entry and no gallons owed out of a pre-buy. Resolved by settle_undrawn_contract_gallons_1dbcf678, owner agent.
 Edge undrawn gallons disposition <- contracted price of record. kind value_input; gate settlement_price; form state; prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the disposition's own rule: "The money applied against a booking on the gallons standing undrawn is worked out only after the account's contracted price of record stands at a price worked out from the bookings the account carries." Four-point test: (1) 'only after'; (2) a record-visible state, the contracted price standing on the account; (3) no code names; (4) hard, and scoped to a price worked out from the bookings rather than the nil price. Exactly one write brings it about: the contracted price of record policy is the only one whose result is the price carried on the account. Unmet at frozen_time: the account's contracted price stands at 0.0000, the nil price an account carries when nothing has been booked on it. Resolved by update_contract_price_of_record_9db7726a, owner agent.
 Edge contracted price of record <- booking credit. kind value_input; gate booked_gal; form state; prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the price policy's own rule: "The contracted price of record is written only after the gallons standing to the member's credit take in every signed pre-buy request registered with the energy desk." Four-point test: (1) 'only after'; (2) a record-visible state, booked gallons standing to the member's credit against the registered signed requests; (3) no code names; (4) hard, scoped to signed requests registered with the desk. Exactly one write brings it about: the booking credit is the only policy whose result is booked gallons on the account. Unmet at frozen_time: the signed pre-buy request of 2025-11-20 for 7000 gallons stands registered and unworked, while the account carries no booking line and shows no gallons owed. Resolved by lodge_contract_gallon_booking_8fcb503b, owner user.
 Topological order: booking credit, contracted price of record, undrawn gallons disposition, closure settlement. The tree is a pure chain, so the order is forced edge by edge and no two writes may be swapped; there are no parallel edges to reorder.
 Per-edge deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping the booking credit moves the contracted price of record from 3.07 to 1.5425; skipping the price of record moves the settlement from 14459.60 to 7275.80; skipping the settlement moves the closing balance from 2782.11 to 17489.64. Every edge bears weight.
 user_scenario mentions no prerequisite: Priscilla asks only that the account be closed and that she be told what it comes to. She names no pre-buy, no booking, no contracted price and no undrawn gallons of her own motion; the one thing she says about the signed request is a passive reply after the agent has told her the cooperative is holding it. The tool layer blocks nothing: close_energy_account_7515982f updates the account with the figure it is given whether or not a booking or a release stands on it, and each of the other three tools performs its one write without reading or judging the others.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Subject energy_contract_gallons_booked is governed by energy_contract_gallons_program, whose eligibility signed_prebuy_booking (kind authorization, authority system_record, timing pre_action, correlated on energy_orders.energy_order_id) requires a signed pre-buy booking registered with the desk before gallons are put to the member's credit: the seeded request of 2025-11-20 is order_type contract_gallons_booking, order_status received and signed_by_member true, and its own reference is what the gold call passes. Subject energy_contract_gallons_booked is also where the price the gallons are credited at is fixed: no base sentence sets it, so this difficulty's own rule does, in the sentence "The price the booked gallons are credited at is the price billed on the most recent will-call stop on or before the day the signed request was registered." The same rule fixes what a will-call stop is, so that the two readings the records allow cannot both stand: "A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking." Base energy_pricing fixes the price of fuel pumped on a stop, not the price a booking is taken at, so nothing is overridden there. Subject energy_account_updated is governed by energy_account_maintenance, whose eligibility account_live_for_maintenance (state, correlated on energy_accounts.account_number) allows an update only while the account stands active, seasonal_hold or past_due: EA-551677 stands active at frozen_time and is closed only at the last write. Subject energy_contract_gallons_drawn is governed by energy_pricing, which carries no structured eligibility for it; subject energy_account_closed by energy_lifecycle_progression, likewise. No time eligibility governs any of the four writes, so temporal_feasibility is empty; the only clock-bound quantities are the windows inside the computations, all measured against frozen_time 2026-11-18.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The object is energy account EA-551677, the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery account on the ridge farm tank, and within it the signed pre-buy request of 2025-11-20 for 7000 gallons. The correlation key back to one request is its own reference, back to one stop the delivery ticket, back to one invoice the invoice number. The member holds exactly one energy account, so no aggregate can stray onto another; every aggregate is in any case scoped to the account being handled. The seven stops, the eight fee lines and the three bank transfers are the whole of the account's history, and the three transfers are correlated to the invoices they cleared: EP-551188 to EI-551201, EP-551241 to EI-551290 and EP-551302 to EI-551361, leaving the October fuel invoice EI-551402 and the handling charge raised with it standing unpaid, which is the 1806.80 the account carries.

FACTOR CARD. energy_ext_prebuy_booking_credit (6 factors). prior_use_window, method: 6 stops in the last twelve months and the tank not on the automatic schedule, so prior use is counted over 6 months rather than 12; the computation document counts 12 and would give 5600. prior_use_measure, method: the window is shorter than a year and the account is in regular use, so the 2420.0 gallons of that window are grossed up to 4840.0; taken as they stand they would give 2600. input_ceiling_share, parameter, cross-difficulty into agronomy: crop input purchases of 75,920.75 over the last twelve months clear the 60,000 input spend and a security interest stands on the input account, so the ceiling share is 110 plus 8; the catalogue's 110 would give 4800. seasonal_use_allowance, parameter: 2420.0 gallons in the last three months clear the 1500 harvest gallons and the 2000 gallon tank clears the large tank mark, so 100 gallons are allowed on top; nothing allowed would give 5100. request_standing_share, parameter: the signed request has stood registered 11 months, past the 9 month mark, and the account is in regular use, so nine tenths of the allowed gallons are credited; the whole of them would give 5800. lot_rounding_rule, method: the request clears the programme's 2500 gallon minimum and two will-call stops fall in the last three months, so the gallons are rounded down to the whole hundred; unrounded they would give 5230.08. Whole baseline: 5742.0 against gold 5200.
energy_ext_contract_price_of_record (5 factors). protection_price_loading, parameter: the programme carries downside protection and 5200.0 gallons stand to her credit, above the 2500 gallon minimum, so 0.0900 is loaded on; nothing loaded gives 3.025. volume_price_adjustment, parameter: 5220.0 gallons over 6 stops in the last twelve months clear the 4000 gallon and 4 stop marks, so 0.0400 comes off; nothing off gives 3.09. whole_farm_price_adjustment, parameter, cross-difficulty into agronomy: 1820.0 acres enrolled clear the 1500 acre mark and the credit department's standing decision is an approval, so 0.0300 comes off; nothing off gives 3.085. booking_standing_loading, parameter: the signed request has stood 11 months and the gallons standing clear the minimum, so 0.0500 is loaded on; nothing loaded gives 3.045. market_truing_rule, method: two called-in stops fall in the last three months and the adjusted 3.0500 sits under the posted price of record of 3.0900, so the price of record is trued to their mean; left at the adjusted price it would be 3.05. Whole baseline: 2.98 against gold 3.07.
energy_ext_undrawn_gallons_disposition (6 factors). settled_gallons_basis, method: 3 stops in the last three months and 5200.0 gallons standing above the 2500 gallon minimum, so the 520.0 gallons of the most recent stop are treated as drawn against the booking and 4680.0 are settled; settling all 5200.0 would give 16069.00. settlement_price_basis, method: 5200.0 gallons clear twice the 2500 gallon minimum and a called-in stop falls in the window, so the settlement price is the mean of 3.0700 and 3.0900, that is 3.0800; the lower of the two, 3.0700, would give 14412.80. cancellation_charge_relief, parameter, cross-difficulty into agronomy: 5220.0 gallons over the last twelve months clear the programme's 2500 gallon annual minimum and the input account's credit standing is an approval, so the cancellation charge is 0.1000 less 0.0400; the catalogue's 0.1000 would give 14272.40. handling_deduction_rate, parameter: the tank is the member's own and 3 stops fall in the last three months, so 0.0150 a gallon is deducted; nothing deducted gives 14529.80. protection_fee_refund, parameter: the programme carries protection and no protection credit has ever been worked out on the account, so the whole 0.0900 a gallon is refunded; nothing refunded gives 14038.40. settlement_admin_charge, parameter: the account has stood open 13.3 years and 5220.0 gallons clear the annual minimum, so the administration charge is 25.00; the short member charge of 75.00 gives 14409.60. Whole baseline: 15369.00 against gold 14459.60.
energy_ext_closure_settlement (4 factors). closing_service_rate, parameter, cross-difficulty into agronomy: the input account's balance of 41,250.75 sits under its 185,000.00 ceiling and its credit standing is an approval, so the rate is 1.25 less 0.45; the programme's 1.25 gives 2798.37. closing_charge_base, method: money has been applied against a booking and money stands committed on it, so the closing charge is worked out on the fuel and fees less the payments, 1806.80, rather than on the whole 2843.20 standing; the whole amount gives 2798.69. closing_month_count, method: the account was last paid 2 whole months ago, at the stale payment mark, and stops fall in the last three months, so the charge runs 2 months; one month gives 2767.65. closing_member_allowance, parameter: 13.3 years open and 5220.0 gallons over the year, so 90.00 comes off; nothing off gives 2872.11. Whole baseline: 2878.74 against gold 2782.11.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS. The seven stops carry the gallons three different windows read, the prices the posted price of record and the posted price of the day are read off, and the gauge readings that make the gallons checkable; delete the stop of 2026-10-28 and the settled gallons, the posted price and the will-call count all move. The eight fee lines are part of the amount standing and of the closing charge base, and the after-hours line of 2026-08-27 is the near-miss: it is the one stop the member did not call in, so it is excluded from every will-call aggregate while still counting as a stop. The three bank transfers fix the amount standing and the month count the closing charge runs for. The signed pre-buy request of 2025-11-20 is the whole root of the chain: it is what the gallons requested, the request age and the eligibility for the booking are read from. The crop input account and its four billing rows are the cross-difficulty evidence for three separate factors: the acres and the credit standing, the input spend, the balance against the ceiling. The account's contracted price of 0.0000 is not a stale cache but the true nil price of an account with nothing booked on it, which is exactly what makes the second prerequisite unmet. Base automatic clauses checked row by row: tank rent is 0.00 and the tank is the member's own, so no rent falls due; the seasonal hold is not in use; the account has never been past due, the oldest unpaid invoice being the October one inside its 20 day terms at frozen_time, so no late charge and no delivery hold is owed by any rule this task does not carry.

PERSONA DESIGN. Priscilla is written as a careful, slightly formal woman reading from notes, apologetic and unhurried, which is deliberately unlike the blunt caller of task 0. She volunteers only that the machinery is gone and the account is finished with, and that she wants the figure on this call. She refuses to guess the balance, which keeps every number in the agent's hands. Her authorisation is explicit: the desk may put through whatever tidying the account needs, but the two acts that are hers - lodging the pre-buy she signed and closing the account - she does herself when they are handed over. Her only word about the pre-buy is a passive reply after the agent raises it, and it carries no gallons, no price and no date beyond the month she remembers signing. Where the agent quotes a figure and hands nothing over she says nothing further and waits: she does not ask whether something is expected of her, so a wrong path draws no correction from her. Her last reaction answers the last gold action and stops there.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION. Locate the member from the membership number she reads out; verify her on the membership number and the tax number; read the energy account; read the whole energy ledger, which is where the stops, fees and transfers behind every aggregate come from; read the energy requests, where the signed pre-buy and its date and gallons are; read the crop input account and its billing, where three cross-difficulty ladders are read. The desk then hands the booking to the member, writes the price of record, settles the undrawn gallons and hands the closing to the member. Everything is under one frozen_time: no truck, no bank clearing, no review and no future date is waited on, and the signed request is an official record that already existed at the opening rather than anything created during the call. Questions a real agent would ask that never enter gold - which account, whether she wants anything written off, how she means to pay - all have definite answers in the persona.

WHAT IS EASILY GOT WRONG. Closing the account on the 1806.80 the record shows and stopping there; missing the signed request altogether, which leaves the price of record at nil and the whole chain unbuilt; counting prior use over twelve months instead of the six the ladder selects, or forgetting to gross those six months up to a year; letting the after-hours stop of 2026-08-27 into the will-call aggregates; settling all 5200.0 gallons instead of holding back the most recent fill; taking the lower of the two prices instead of their mean; and working the closing charge on the whole amount standing instead of on the fuel and fees less the payments.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Read the ledger and the request. Book the gallons: 2420.0 gallons over six months grossed to 4840.0, at 118 percent that is 5711.2 plus a 100 gallon seasonal allowance, so the ceiling is 5811.2; the request of 7000 is the larger, so 5811.2 stands, nine tenths of it is 5230.08, and rounded down to the whole hundred the member is credited 5200 gallons. The price they are credited at is 2.9800: the only will-call stop on or before the day the request was registered, 2025-11-20, is the stop of 2025-10-15 billed at 2.9800, every later stop falling after the request and the stop of 2026-08-27 being recorded as run after hours, which the rule's own definition of a will-call stop excludes. Write the price of record: the weighted average 2.9800 plus 0.0900 protection, less 0.0400 volume and 0.0300 whole-farm, plus 0.0500 standing, is 3.0500; trued against the posted 3.0900 that is 3.0700. Settle the undrawn gallons: 5200.0 standing less the 520.0 of the last stop is 4680.0, at the mean price 3.0800 with 0.0900 refunded and 0.0600 and 0.0150 taken off, less 25.00 administration, giving 14459.60. Then close: 18526.80 of fuel plus 305.00 of fees less 17025.00 of payments plus 15496.00 committed less 14459.60 released is 2843.20 standing; the charge base is 1806.80 at 0.80 percent for two months, that is 28.91; less the 90.00 allowance the account closes at 2782.11.

VERIFICATION RUN. Every computation was reproduced binding by binding on its own handling-time world with the gate's own restricted evaluator (skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py build_env/eval_compute), each evaluated on initial_state plus the gold writes preceding it. Output: booking credit 5200 (whole baseline 5742.0; per-factor baselines 5600, 2600, 4800, 5100, 5800, 5230.08); contracted price of record 3.07 (whole baseline 2.98; per-factor baselines 3.025, 3.09, 3.085, 3.045, 3.05); undrawn gallons settlement 14459.60 (whole baseline 15369.00; per-factor baselines 16069.00, 14412.80, 14272.40, 14529.80, 14038.40, 14409.60); closing balance 2782.11 (whole baseline 2878.74; per-factor baselines 2798.37, 2798.69, 2767.65, 2872.11). Prerequisite sensitivity: without the booking the price of record is 1.5425, without the price of record the settlement is 7275.80, without the settlement the closing balance is 17489.64.

CLOSURE. energy_ext_prebuy_booking_credit -> lodge_contract_gallon_booking_8fcb503b -> computations[0] -> action 8 -> a booking line of 5200.0 gallons at 2.9800 on EA-551677. energy_ext_contract_price_of_record -> update_contract_price_of_record_9db7726a -> computations[1] -> action 10 -> the account's contracted price rewritten to 3.0700. energy_ext_undrawn_gallons_disposition -> settle_undrawn_contract_gallons_1dbcf678 -> computations[2] -> action 12 -> a release of 4680.0 gallons applying 14459.60. energy_ext_closure_settlement -> close_energy_account_7515982f -> computations[3] -> action 14 -> the account closed at 2782.11. charter_scope, required_documents and the computation policy ids are the same four ids in the same order, and that order is the topological order of the chain. The pre-write eligibility evidence in solvability_contract is the signed request row for the booking gate and the account row for the maintenance gate, each correlated to the argument the blueprint's action_bindings fix; the two remaining writes are governed by scope alone. The declared overrides this task rests on are: energy_contract_gallons_program's booking-ceiling sentence; its unused-gallons-treatment sentence and, now, its cancellation-charge sentence, superseded by the disposition policy's own cancellation charge per gallon with the active member relief; energy_account_maintenance's contracted-price sentence; and energy_lifecycle_progression's member-closure sentence, superseded by "A member closes an account of their own accord whatever stands on it, and the balance the account closes at is written onto the account as what is owed and follows the member rather than being extinguished." That last one is what makes the scored close legal on an account that still owes money, and it follows base's own treatment of a balance that follows the member rather than being extinguished. Base's parameter values (contract_cancellation_fee_per_gallon_usd 0.1000, finance_charge_monthly_pct 1.25) remain valid and base-homed and are exactly what those ladders' fall-throughs select. Superseding that sentence also retires the base ordering clause it contains, so the only statement in force about what the closure waits on is the closure policy's own prerequisite sentence.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Masking the charter, compute, expected and gold, and working only from the manuals that will be published, the tool schemas, the rows the finders return and what Priscilla actually says: the closure manual says outright that the closing balance is fixed only after the account carries, for every signed pre-buy request the desk holds registered against it, the money applied against a booking on released gallons; the request lookup shows one such request standing unworked and the ledger carries no release entry, so that state is false and the disposition manual is reached, which says its figure is worked out only after the contracted price of record stands at a price worked out from the bookings; the account shows 0.0000, so the price manual is reached, which says it is written only after the gallons standing take in every signed request registered - and the request lookup shows one signed, received and unworked. Working the four documents' own figures in that order gives 5200, 3.0700, 14459.60 and 2782.11, the same four numbers and the same order as gold, with no second reading available: the member holds one energy account, one signed request stands, and each ladder's tiers are pairwise disjoint on the records as they stand.

REVISION 2 (source-layer policy-task audit, round 2). Symptoms, causes, changes and re-runs, keyed to the audit's item ids. C1: the root's prerequisite sentence quantified over bookings on the account, and the opening world carries none, so it was vacuously true and a reader walking down from the root reached no prerequisite at all — a defensible 1745.71 instead of 2782.11; cause, the wrong thing quantified over; change, the sentence and its condition now quantify over the signed pre-buy requests the energy desk holds registered against the account, of which one stands unanswered at the opening, so the state is false as a matter of world fact and the chain is entered from the root; the why_false and the evidence now cite the request row rather than the absence of bookings; re-run, every figure unchanged (5200 / 3.07 / 14459.60 / 2782.11) because nothing in any compute moved. T1: the price the booked gallons are credited at was fixed by no rule in force, leaving four defensible readings and so four defensible closing balances, and the tracing asserted a stop on a date the world does not carry; cause, a load-bearing tool argument with no exclusive basis; change, the booking policy's rule now fixes it — the price billed on the most recent will-call stop on or before the day the signed request was registered — which on this world is the will-call stop of 2025-10-15 at 2.9800 and nothing else, and the tracing quotes that sentence and works the exclusion out stop by stop; re-run, 2.9800 is unchanged, so every downstream figure is unchanged. F4: the cancellation charge per gallon was taken from a ladder while base fixed it; cause, an undeclared override; change, base's cancellation sentence is named in the disposition policy's overwrite against its own active-member-relief sentence. F5: base forbids a member-initiated closure while anything is owed and the closure policy declared nothing; cause, overwrite was empty; change, base's member-closure sentence is named in overwrite and the rule carries the sentence that takes its place, so closing an account that still owes money is a declared version update rather than a silent departure, and the step-14 scope entry no longer asserts the retired sentence satisfied. O1: the third tiers of prior_use_measure and volume_price_adjustment are now written as the residual, so each stated ladder exhausts the space its compute branch covers; no world lands differently. O2: baseline.params on the contracted-price policy is now empty and on the reconciliation policy names only plan_window_months, since those baseline paragraphs read no other quantitative key. O6: the closing_month_count tier that added a month for inactivity now says the charge runs together with the month the account closes in, which is the ordinary convention and the same arithmetic; the tier does not fire here. O9: the persona no longer asks whether something is expected of her when nothing is handed over — she simply waits, so no wrong path draws a correction. O5 (the Bulk programme carrying pre-buy while pricing at rack plus margin) is a blueprint-level fact that cannot be edited from here and changes no figure: the contracted price of record governs only the settlement price at step 3, which is exactly how this chain uses it. The withdrawn T2 and T3 were re-checked after every change above: on this world the truing rule takes its second tier, the whole baseline of the contracted price is 2.98 against a gold of 3.07, and all twenty-one factors still move their result. Every per-task and difficulty-wide gate was re-run and is green.

REVISION 3 (render-layer audit, round 3). This task passed the render-layer audit on all three parts and none of its scored figures moved: 5200 / 3.07 / 14459.60 / 2782.11 stand exactly as they were, confirmed by re-running the compute gate after every change. Three charter-level items were closed and they touch this task's wording only. P3: the phrase "stops the member called in" was bound to the will-call delivery type by the compute binding alone, so an after-hours stop was silently not one; the rules now say "will-call stops" and each policy that uses the term defines it once in its own words — "A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking." That matters here because the booking price rests on exactly this distinction: the stop of 2026-08-27 is recorded as run after hours, and only the rule's own definition keeps it out of the reckoning. The two tier wordings the change touched — lot_rounding_rule tier 1 and settlement_price_basis tier 1 — are restated in factor_sensitivity, and every count on this world clears its threshold on the new words exactly as it did on the old. P2: the closing sum's prose said the money applied against bookings was taken "when gallons standing undrawn were released" while its binding sums every drawdown row, a fill drawn against a booking included; the prose now says "whether on a fill drawn against them or on a release of gallons standing undrawn", which is what the binding does. This account carries no contract fill, so the figure is unchanged at 2843.20 standing and 2782.11 closing, but the two readings no longer part on any world. The prerequisite sentence, which waits on the release entry specifically, is deliberately left as it was: it gates on the write the settlement makes, not on the sum. P1 belongs to task 0 and does not touch this task. D2 is a document-side note for the re-render.
user_scenario:
Priscilla Nordbeck has farmed the ridge ground north of Forest City since her father handed it over, and this autumn she has let the row-crop acres to a younger neighbour on a five-year lease. She is a careful, slightly formal woman who reads from notes she has written out beforehand, and she apologises for taking up the agent's time more often than she needs to. What she has written at the top of her notes is that the bulk farm diesel account is finished with: the combine and the tractors went at the sale in October, there is nothing left on the place that burns diesel, and she wants the account closed off properly and told what she owes to be done with it. She would like that settled on this call rather than left to a letter.

She gives her membership number, M-55471, at the start, reading it off the last statement. Asked for anything further to prove who she is, she offers the last four figures of the farm's tax number, 5547, and if the agent wants a third thing she gives the mobile number, 5150553308. Internal reference numbers mean nothing to her and she says so. She has only ever had the one fuel account with the cooperative, the farm tank on the ridge, and she says so if asked which one she means.

She does not know what the account stands at and declines to guess, saying the bookkeeping was her husband's side of things and she would rather be told the figure from the record than put a wrong one about. She is not asking for anything to be written off and she is not haggling; she says she will pay whatever the account comes to, and she would rather hear one final figure than a running commentary. She tells the agent plainly that they may put whatever tidying the account needs through, so long as she is told what it comes to at the end.

If the agent tells her the cooperative is holding a pre-buy she signed that never went onto the account, she does remember putting her name to something in the November before last, when the fuel man came round with the forms, and she says that if her signature is on it then it ought to be on the account properly and she will put it on herself if that is what is wanted. When the agent hands that over to her she does it there and then, without asking what it will cost her. In the same way, when the agent has the closing figure and hands the closing over for her to do in person, she does it, reads the figure back once to be sure she has heard it right, and says she will put a cheque in the post for it this week. Then she thanks the agent for sorting out what she calls a long tail of a thing and rings off. If the agent only quotes her a figure and hands nothing over, she says nothing further about it and waits.

base_preconditions.condition: An account reaching a terminal state is governed by the lifecycle rules for closure and tank removal: a member-owned tank is not pulled and the account simply closes, a closed or finished account is terminal, and a member coming back needs a fresh application and a fresh tank set. The sentence this policy states about a member closing an account with nothing owing is superseded clause by clause by energy_ext_closure_settlement, which states that the balance the account closes at is written onto it as what is owed and follows the member.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the membership profile from the number the caller reads off her statement, so the desk knows whose energy account is being closed and holds her internal member reference.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later lookup and every write is keyed to the member's internal reference, which only this profile lookup returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check the two details the caller states against the membership profile and record that identity cleared on this call.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing may be read or written on the account until identity clears; the membership number and the last four of the tax number are the two details she offers.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's energy account: the programme, the fuel, the tank and who owns it, the route, the contracted gallons and contracted price it currently shows, the keep-full enrolment, the opening date and the balance carried.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier, the tank capacity, the keep-full enrolment, the opening date and the contracted price of 0.0000 feed the prior-use window, the seasonal allowance, the handling, the administration and allowance ladders, and the nil contracted price is how the second prerequisite is seen to be unmet.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole energy ledger: the seven stops with their gauge readings, prices and delivery types, the eight fee lines and the three bank transfers, and confirm that no booking line and no release stands on the account.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every history aggregate in all four computations is taken off these rows, and their silence about any booking is how the first and third prerequisites are seen to be unmet.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the requests the member has lodged with the energy desk, which shows one pre-buy booking request of 2025-11-20 for 7000 gallons, signed by the member and still standing as received.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The gallons requested and the date the request was registered are read from this row, and it is the authoritative evidence for the signed pre-buy booking the base policy requires before gallons go to a member's credit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's crop input account: the acres enrolled, the security interest, the credit ceiling, the balance carried and the credit department's standing decision.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Four cross-difficulty tiers rest on these fields: the ceiling share, the whole-farm price adjustment, the cancellation charge relief and the closing service rate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the crop input billing: the three invoices raised over the season and the payment posted against them.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The crop input purchases over the twelve months are what the booking ceiling share is tiered on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own pre-buy lodging tool and hand it over, so the gallons she signed for go to her credit by her own act.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Booking contract gallons is the member's own disposal of her own money; the agent unlocks it at this point in the order and the member runs it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Put the gallons of the signed pre-buy request to the member's credit on EA-551677 at the price the gallons were booked at.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551677. Basis: the member says "She has only ever had the one fuel account with the cooperative, the farm tank on the ridge", and the account lookup returns exactly that one account. Uniqueness: no second energy account of hers exists, and the signed request itself is registered against this account.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_order_id: The internal reference of the signed pre-buy request of 2025-11-20. Basis: the base rule for pre-buy states that "A signed pre-buy booking is registered with the energy desk before the gallons are put to the member's credit, and the money is taken at the booking rather than at delivery", and the energy request lookup returns exactly one request of order_type contract_gallons_booking, signed by the member and standing as received. Uniqueness: it is the only request on her record of any kind, so no other reference could be passed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.price_per_gallon: 2.9800. Basis: the pre-buy rule fixes it outright — "The price the booked gallons are credited at is the price billed on the most recent will-call stop on or before the day the signed request was registered." The same rule fixes what a will-call stop is: "A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking." The signed request was registered on 2025-11-20. Uniqueness: exactly one will-call stop falls on or before that day on this account, ticket ET-6709884 of 2025-10-15, billed at 2.9800; the stop of 2025-12-08 and every later one fall after the request was registered, and the stop of 2026-08-27 is recorded as run after hours, so it is not a will-call stop on the rule's own words. No other price on the account answers the sentence and 2.9800 is the only reading.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.booked_gallons: 5200, the figure energy_ext_prebuy_booking_credit computes. Six stops stand in the last twelve months and the tank is not on the automatic keep-full schedule, so prior use is counted over six months: 2420.0 gallons, grossed up to a full year as 4840.0. The member's crop input purchases of 75,920.75 clear the 60,000 input spend and a security interest stands on the input account, so the ceiling share is 110 plus 8, giving 5711.2, and 2420.0 gallons in the last three months with a 2000 gallon tank add a 100 gallon seasonal allowance, so the ceiling is 5811.2. The request of 7000 gallons is the larger, so 5811.2 stands; the request has been registered 11 months with the account in regular use, so nine tenths of it, 5230.08, is allowed; and with the request above the programme's 2500 gallon minimum and two called-in stops in the last three months the gallons are rounded down to the whole hundred, giving 5200.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's contracted price tool named by the price of record policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair; it changes nothing in the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Write the contracted price of record onto EA-551677 from the booking now standing on it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: energy_ext_contract_price_of_record is the only policy that computes contract_price_per_gallon, and the price it writes is what the undrawn gallons are later settled at.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551677, the one energy account the member holds and the account the booking was just lodged on. Basis: the account lookup returns one account for this member. Uniqueness: there is no second account whose contracted price could be in question.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.account_number: EA-551677. Basis: the account record carries it, and the schema fixes its form as EA- followed by six digits. Uniqueness: it is the account number printed on the delivery tickets and statements of the only account she holds, returned verbatim by the account lookup.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contract_price_per_gallon: 3.0700, the figure energy_ext_contract_price_of_record computes. The one booking standing carries 5200.0 gallons at 2.9800, so the gallons-weighted average is 2.9800. The programme carries downside protection and 5200.0 gallons stand above the 2500 gallon minimum, so 0.0900 is loaded on. 5220.0 gallons over six stops in the last twelve months clear the 4000 gallon and four stop marks, so 0.0400 comes off. 1820.0 acres enrolled clear the 1500 acre mark and the input account's credit standing is an approval, so 0.0300 comes off. The signed request has stood registered 11 months, past the nine month mark, with the gallons standing above the minimum, so 0.0500 is loaded on. That gives an adjusted 3.0500. Two will-call stops fall in the last three months and 3.0500 sits at or under the posted price of record of 3.0900, so the price of record is their mean, 3.0700.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's undrawn gallons settlement tool named by the disposition policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair; it changes nothing in the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Release the gallons standing undrawn on the booking and apply the money they come to against it, so the account can be closed with no gallons standing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: energy_ext_undrawn_gallons_disposition is the only policy that computes undrawn_settlement_usd, and the money it applies is what the closing balance is worked out net of.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551677, the account carrying the booking whose gallons stand undrawn. Basis: the account lookup returns one account. Uniqueness: the booking exists on no other account of hers.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.gallons: 4680.0. Basis: the disposition rule states that where two or more stops were billed in the three months and the gallons standing reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, "the gallons settled are the gallons standing undrawn less the gallons the most recent stop took, that fill being treated as drawn against the booking". Uniqueness: 5200.0 gallons stand undrawn with nothing yet drawn, three stops fall in the three months to 2026-11-18, and the most recent of them, the stop of 2026-10-28, took 520.0 gallons, leaving 4680.0 and no other reading.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.settlement_price_per_gallon: 3.0800. Basis: the rule states that where the gallons standing reach twice the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and a called-in stop falls in the window, "the settlement price is the mean of the contracted price of record and the posted price of the day, carried to four decimal places". Uniqueness: 5200.0 gallons clear twice the 2500 gallon minimum, two called-in stops fall in the window, the contracted price of record now standing on the account is 3.0700 and the posted price of the day, taken from the most recent called-in stop, is 3.0900; their mean is 3.0800.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.undrawn_settlement_usd: 14459.60, the figure energy_ext_undrawn_gallons_disposition computes. 4680.0 gallons are settled at 3.0800. The programme carries protection and no protection credit has ever been worked out on the account, so 0.0900 a gallon is refunded. 5220.0 gallons over the last twelve months clear the programme's 2500 gallon annual minimum and the input account's credit standing is an approval, so the cancellation charge is 0.1000 less 0.0400, that is 0.0600 a gallon. The tank is the member's own with three stops in the last three months, so 0.0150 a gallon is deducted for handling. That is 3.0950 a gallon on 4680.0 gallons, 14484.60, less the 25.00 administration charge the account earns at 13.3 years open with 5220.0 gallons over the year, giving 14459.60.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own closing tool and hand it over, so she closes the account herself.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Closing an energy account is the member's own act over her own account; the agent unlocks it last in the order and the member runs it.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: energy_ext_closure_settlement is the only policy that computes closing_balance_usd, and this is the write the member actually asked for.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.energy_account_id: The internal reference of energy account EA-551677. Basis: the member asks for "the bulk farm diesel account" to be closed and says she has only ever had the one fuel account. Uniqueness: the account lookup returns exactly one energy account for her.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.closing_balance_usd: 2782.11, the figure energy_ext_closure_settlement computes on the account as it stands once the booking, the price of record and the release are on it. The amount standing is 18526.80 of fuel plus 305.00 of fees less 17025.00 of payments plus 15496.00 committed on the booking less 14459.60 applied against it, that is 2843.20. Money has been applied against a booking and money stands committed on it, so the closing charge is worked out on the fuel and fees less the payments, 1806.80. The input account's balance of 41,250.75 sits under its 185,000.00 ceiling with an approved credit standing, so the rate is 1.25 less 0.45, that is 0.80 percent a month, and the account was last paid two whole months ago with stops in the last three months, so the charge runs two months: 28.91. The account has stood open 13.3 years with 5220.0 gallons over the year, so 90.00 comes off. 2843.20 plus 28.91 less 90.00 is 2782.11.

edges.condition: Every signed pre-buy request the energy desk holds registered against the account is answered by an entry on the account for the money applied against a booking when gallons standing undrawn were released.
edges.policy_source: The balance the account closes at is fixed only after the account carries, for every signed pre-buy request the energy desk holds registered against it, the money applied against a booking when gallons standing undrawn were released.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The energy desk holds one signed pre-buy request registered against this account — 7000 gallons asked for on 2025-11-20, standing as received and signed by the member — and nothing on the account answers it: the ledger holds seven stops, eight fee lines and three bank transfers and no entry for money applied against any booking, and the account shows no gallons owed out of a pre-buy. The state the closing figure waits on is therefore false on a registered request that exists, not vacuously true on an empty set.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Settling the undrawn gallons puts a drawdown entry of 14459.60 against the booking dated 2026-11-18, so the one registered request is answered by money applied against a booking and amount_standing_d falls from 17302.80 to 2843.20.

edges.condition: The contracted price of record standing on the account is a price worked out from the bookings the account carries rather than the nil price an account carries where nothing has been booked.
edges.policy_source: The money applied against a booking on the gallons standing undrawn is worked out only after the account's contracted price of record stands at a price worked out from the bookings the account carries.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The contracted price standing on the account is 0.0000, the nil price an account carries where nothing has been booked on it, so it is not a price worked out from any booking.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Writing the contracted price of record puts 3.0700 on the account, so the settlement price the gallons are released at moves from the nil price to 3.0800, the mean of 3.0700 and the posted 3.0900.

edges.condition: Every signed pre-buy request registered with the energy desk is carried by booked gallons standing to the member's credit on the account.
edges.policy_source: The contracted price of record is written only after the gallons standing to the member's credit take in every signed pre-buy request registered with the energy desk.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: A pre-buy request for 7000 gallons signed by the member stands registered with the energy desk as received, and no booked gallons stand to her credit against it: the account shows no contracted gallons and the ledger carries no booking line.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Lodging the booking puts 5200.0 gallons at 2.9800 to the member's credit, so booked_gal moves from 0.0 to 5200.0 and the gallons-weighted average the price of record is built on takes the value 2.9800.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a pure chain with no parallel edges, so no two writes may be reordered and no order argument is needed for parallel prerequisites: each problem reads what its predecessor writes. The contracted price of record is built on the gallons-weighted average of the bookings, which is nothing until the booking is lodged; the settlement price is read off the contracted price standing on the account, which is 0.0000 until the price of record is written; and the amount standing the closing balance is worked out on is net of the money applied against the booking, which is nothing until the gallons are released. The Step 5 run confirms each link: 1.5425 against 3.07, 7275.80 against 14459.60 and 17489.64 against 2782.11.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the settlement and replaying everything else leaves no money applied against the booking, so amount_standing_d rises to 17302.80 and the scored closing_balance_usd moves from 2782.11 to 17489.64.
Skipping the price of record leaves the account's contracted price at 0.0000, so the settlement price falls from 3.0800 to 1.5450 and the scored undrawn_settlement_usd moves from 14459.60 to 7275.8.
Skipping the booking leaves no booking line on the account, so the gallons-weighted average is nothing and the scored contract_price_per_gallon moves from 3.07 to 1.5425.

An agent that skips a link is answered normally and differs from gold only in the terminal hash.
